Bromius/ArmourShatterInstinctSkill.name: Barkbare
Bromius/ArmourShatterInstinctSkill.desc: Chance to steal Physical and Magick defense from Foes on strike, and grant it to oneself.
Bromius/ArmourShatterInstinctSkill.detail: Barkbare grants most attacks a 10% Chance to steal Armour from the struck Foe, per rank invested in the Barkbare Pact Art. At max rank, the chance is 40%.

Bromius/ReflectArmourlInstinctSkill.name: Canopy's Blessing
Bromius/ReflectArmourlInstinctSkill.desc: Reflects a small amount of damage blocked by armour back to the enemy.
Bromius/ReflectArmourlInstinctSkill.detail: When an Enemy strikes the Envoy, they will immediately suffer a portion of the Damage that was mitigated by the Envoy's Armour. Amount is 8% of Mitigated Damage per rank of the Canopy's Blessing Pact Art.

Fencer/DodgeyDecoySkill.name: Chamariz
Fencer/DodgeyDecoySkill.desc: Dodges following a Perfect Dodge will leave behind clones of the Envoy, attracting enemy aggro for a number of seconds.
Fencer/DodgeyDecoySkill.detail: After a Perfect Dodge, the next [1 / 2 / 3 / 4] dodges will spawn a decoy that draws attention. Decoys last ~1 second.

Fencer/HealthPotionMaxStackUpgradeSkill.name: Physic
Fencer/HealthPotionMaxStackUpgradeSkill.desc: Survival graces the well-prepared. Increase the amount of Life Elixirs you can carry.
Fencer/HealthPotionMaxStackUpgradeSkill.detail: Increases Life Elixir capacity by one per point invested.

Fencer/PokeyPokeySkill.name: Olho por Olho
Fencer/PokeyPokeySkill.desc: The next three hits after a dodge have a chance to inflict a Bleed proc upon damaged Foes.
Fencer/PokeyPokeySkill.detail: Chance to apply a Bleed proc when attacking for the next successful melee hit/three successful ranged hits after Dodging. Chance scales with rank in the Olho por Olho Pact Art - The first hit has a 6% / 12% / 18% / 24% chance to inflict Bleed, and subsequent hits if applicable have a significantly lower chance.

Fenn/FanTheFlamesInstinctSkill.name: Hungry Flame
Fenn/FanTheFlamesInstinctSkill.desc: Taking fire damage temporarily buffs the Envoy's Weapon Damage.
Fenn/FanTheFlamesInstinctSkill.detail: Taking Flame damage temporarily buffs the Envoy's Weapon damage. Activating Ember also triggers the buff.

Fenn/SlowBoilInstinctSkill.name: Smolder
Fenn/SlowBoilInstinctSkill.desc: Targeted enemy takes ever-increasing tick damage and is eventually set on fire.
Fenn/SlowBoilInstinctSkill.detail: The target takes ever-increasing tick damage, and is eventually Ignited. Tick damage happens 4 seconds after targeting an Enemy.

Fey/BirdTimeUpgradeSkill.name: Wingspan
Fey/BirdTimeUpgradeSkill.desc: When you fall, your Sparrow Soul has more time to return to your body.
Fey/BirdTimeUpgradeSkill.detail: Increases time until a fallen Envoy is forcibly revived at a Revive Shrine by 7 / 14 seconds depending on points invested.

Fey/CourageVirtueUpgradeSkill.name: Mora's Pride
Fey/CourageVirtueUpgradeSkill.desc: A pact under the red sun. Gain Courage.

Fey/FeySightInstinctSkill.name: Shrouded
Fey/FeySightInstinctSkill.desc: Able to see enemies through walls whilst using Spectral Sight.
Fey/FeySightInstinctSkill.detail: Detection range scales with points into Shrouded, but not with any virtue. Also detects fauna & teammates.

Fey/FeyStealInstinctSkill.name: Pickpocket
Fey/FeyStealInstinctSkill.desc: Unalerted enemies drop loot if the Envoy stays next to them.
Fey/FeyStealInstinctSkill.detail: Once pickpocketed, an Enemy will no longer carry any loot to drop after its death. Additional points increase pickpocketing speed.

Fey/GraceVirtueUpgradeSkill.name: Saphene's Gift
Fey/GraceVirtueUpgradeSkill.desc: A pact under the blue sun. Gain Grace.

Fey/KillersHandInstinctSkill.name: Conquerer
Fey/KillersHandInstinctSkill.desc: Restores a small amount of Life with each foe slain.
Fey/KillersHandInstinctSkill.detail: Regain [25 / 30 / 40 / 60] Life per kill, scaling with points in the Conquerer Pact Art. Life restored is not affected by the Healer Art.

Fey/LastStandInstinctSkill.name: Last Stand
Fey/LastStandInstinctSkill.desc: Increased attack speed while below 45% Life.
Fey/LastStandInstinctSkill.detail: Attack speed buff begins at +28% and increases by 8% per rank of the Last Stand Pact Art, reaching a maximum of +52% at Rank 4. Also benefits heavy attacks, throws, and Finishers.

Fey/PreventDeathUpgradeSkill.name: Forestall
Fey/PreventDeathUpgradeSkill.desc: Cheat death once more. Gain a chance to survive where otherwise you would die.

Fey/PreventStabilityBreakUpgradeSkill.name: Stalwart
Fey/PreventStabilityBreakUpgradeSkill.desc: Stand tall. Gain a chance to resist being knocked down.

Fey/SpiritVirtueUpgradeSkill.name: Iridis' Favour
Fey/SpiritVirtueUpgradeSkill.desc: A pact under the green moon. Gain Spirit.

Fey/StabilityUpgradeSkill.name: Rooted
Fey/StabilityUpgradeSkill.desc: Grounded by pact, your defence against Stagger is heightened.
Fey/StabilityUpgradeSkill.detail: Reduces Stagger damage taken by approximately 50% at max rank.

Fey/StandingWaterInstinctSkill.name: Vernal Pool
Fey/StandingWaterInstinctSkill.desc: Cooldown reduction for all abilities while standing in/on water.
Fey/StandingWaterInstinctSkill.detail: Regenerates 1.5 / 3 / 4 / 5 'Cooldown Seconds' per Second while in water, depending on Rank of the Vernal Pool Pact Art. On Phantom Flock, the first Rank appears to be 2 Cooldown seconds per second.

Fey/WardThornsInstinctSkill.name: Tendril
Fey/WardThornsInstinctSkill.desc: Chance to ensnare enemies who attack the Envoy, freezing them in place for several seconds.
Fey/WardThornsInstinctSkill.detail: Chance to ensnare is 6% per point spent in the Tendril Pact Art. Applies to any Enemy that the Envoy has Blocked, Parried, or taken Damage from.

Garren/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.name: Healheart
Garren/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.desc: Upon healing via Regain, Torment or Totems, gain an additional hidden charge for the equipped Rune which is revealed upon activation.
Garren/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.detail: At any time, Heal any amount of lost Life via specific methods to renew the charge of the equipped Rune by approximately 50/70/95/110% of a single charge, scaling with points into the Healheart Pact Art. Note that the charge renewed by Healheart is invisible until the Rune is activated.

Garren/InstinctBUpgradeSkill.name: Righteous
Garren/InstinctBUpgradeSkill.desc: Reduces the base cooldown duration of the Behest arcanic.
Garren/InstinctBUpgradeSkill.detail: Reduces the base cooldown duration of Behest by 7.5 Seconds per rank, up to a maximum of 30 Seconds.

Ode/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.name: Lightning Strike
Ode/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.desc: The first strike of a ground finisher deals an additional instance of damage.
Ode/InstinctAUpgradeSkill.detail: Performing a Ground Finisher on a downed Foe will trigger an extra hit dealing 45/50/55/65 Voltaic Damage on the target and any nearby enemies. The extra hits are not Finishers, and will have their damage reduced by Enemy Armour accordingly.

Ode/InstinctbUpgradeSkill.name: Gravitate
Ode/InstinctbUpgradeSkill.desc: Kick whilst facing an enemy at range to grapple towards them, charging the Envoy's next melee or thrown attack with additional Voltaic damage.
Ode/InstinctbUpgradeSkill.detail: Performing a Kick towards a Foe from up to ~14m away will grapple the Envoy towards the target, and grant an extra hit dealing 0/5/11/22 Voltaic damage on their next attack. Unlike other Pact-specific kicks, at least one point must be invested in the Gravitate Pact Art for the grapple to be performed.

Wolf/WolfPackPassveUpgradeSkill.name: Soulbound
Wolf/WolfPackPassveUpgradeSkill.desc: Weapon damage increased per nearby ally.
Wolf/WolfPackPassveUpgradeSkill.detail: Damage increase scales with points into Soulbound. Increase per ally per Pact Art point invested: [2 / 3 / 4 / 5].

Wolf/WolfPassveUpgradeSkill.name: Feral
Wolf/WolfPassveUpgradeSkill.desc: Orengall randomly appears to take down an enemy, killing them instantly before leaving.
Wolf/WolfPassveUpgradeSkill.detail: Proc chance scales with points into the Feral Pact Art. Does not proc on bosses.
